5f31a563785010de884a8e74ebb38339c34ba467.definition: The best deal you can make if the deal in front of you does not happen.
5f31a563785010de884a8e74ebb38339c34ba467.gloss: The best deal you can make if the deal in front of you does not happen.

5f31a563785010de884a8e74ebb38339c34ba467.definition: BATNAは、交渉中の取引が不成立になった場合の最良の代替案のこと。交渉takes前に weakest案や底线をgreatelyために算出する。
5f31a563785010de884a8e74ebb38339c34ba467.gloss: Currently表されている取引が成立しなかった場合に、最良の代替取引。

5f31a563785010de884a8e74ebb38339c34ba467.definition: BATNA는 현재 제안이 받아들여지지 않을 경우 선택할 수 있는 가장 좋은 대안이다. 협상 전에 그 대안의 조건을 구체적으로 정해 두는 것이 중요하다.
5f31a563785010de884a8e74ebb38339c34ba467.gloss: 현재 거래가 성사되지 않을 때 선택할 수 있는 가장 유리한 대안.

5f31a563785010de884a8e74ebb38339c34ba467.definition: BATNA é a melhor opção disponível se a negociação em andamento não resultar em acordo. É usada em negociações para comparar o valor de uma proposta com o que se pode obter em outro lugar.
5f31a563785010de884a8e74ebb38339c34ba467.gloss: A melhor alternativa caso a negociação atual não seja concluída.

5f31a563785010de884a8e74ebb38339c34ba467.definition: BATNA merupakan alternatif cadangan dan titik kekuatansomeone ketika bernegosiasi. Semakin kuat alternatif ini, semakin besarpressão yang dapat diberikan pihak lain.
5f31a563785010de884a8e74ebb38339c34ba467.gloss: BATNA adalah kesepakatan terbaik yang dapat dicapai jika negosiasi yang sedang berjalan gagal.

5f31a563785010de884a8e74ebb38339c34ba467.gloss: ข้อตกลงที่ดีที่สุดที่ทำได้หากข้อตกลงที่กำลังเจรจาไม่สำเร็จ

5f97e3774c51edd1d63706c2ec3826c564a06779.definition: The fixed vocabulary a model uses, plus the rule that splits text into tokens and joins them back.

5f97e3774c51edd1d63706c2ec3826c564a06779.definition: 文章をトークンへ分割したり、トークンから文章を復元したりする仕組みをいう。処理方式や語彙が異なると、同じ文章でもトークン数が変わる。

5f97e3774c51edd1d63706c2ec3826c564a06779.definition: 모델이 사용하는 고정된 어휘 목록과 함께 텍스트를 조각으로 나누는 규칙을 가리킨다. 처리 방식이 달라지면 같은 문장에 필요한 토큰 수도 달라진다.

5faa949ff970842c2f50aa3e664971d0fa3b4c36.definition: The grip between the tyre and the road, and it is what turns the car's speed into a stop.
5faa949ff970842c2f50aa3e664971d0fa3b4c36.gloss: The grip between the tyre and the road, and it is what turns the car's speed into a stop.

5faa949ff970842c2f50aa3e664971d0fa3b4c36.definition: タイヤと路面の摩擦によって得られる、駆動力および制動力を支える力。路面が濡れているinatingFooter veterinær Examplesでは、很低：
5faa949ff970842c2f50aa3e664971d0fa3b4c36.gloss: タイヤと路面の間にはたらく、車を停止させるためのグリップ。

5faa949ff970842c2f50aa3e664971d0fa3b4c36.definition: 타이어와 도로 사이의 그립력을 이룬다. 자동차의 속도를 줄이는 데 관여하며, 미끄러운 길에서는 약해진다.
5faa949ff970842c2f50aa3e664971d0fa3b4c36.gloss: 타이어와 도로 사이의 그립력으로 자동차의 속도를 멈추게 한다.

5faa949ff970842c2f50aa3e664971d0fa3b4c36.definition: Aderência entre o pneu e o piso da via. Ela é menor em superfícies escorregadias, como gelo ou lama.
5faa949ff970842c2f50aa3e664971d0fa3b4c36.gloss: Aderência entre o pneu e a pista, que permite frear o carro.

5faa949ff970842c2f50aa3e664971d0fa3b4c36.definition: Gaya cengkeraman antara ban dan permukaan jalan. Cengkeraman yang rendah membuat kendaraan meluncur meskipun kecepatannya rendah.
5faa949ff970842c2f50aa3e664971d0fa3b4c36.gloss: Cengkeraman antara ban dan jalan yang memungkinkan kendaraan melambat hingga berhenti.

5faa949ff970842c2f50aa3e664971d0fa3b4c36.definition: ความสามารถของยางรถในการยึดเกาะกับผิวถนน ซึ่งมีผลต่อการเร่ง การเลี้ยว และระยะเบรก โดยบนพื้นลื่นแรงยึดเกาะจะน้อยลง
5faa949ff970842c2f50aa3e664971d0fa3b4c36.gloss: แรงยึดเกาะระหว่างยางรถกับถนน ทำให้ความเร็วของรถเปลี่ยนเป็นการหยุด

5faa949ff970842c2f50aa3e664971d0fa3b4c36.definition: Lastik ile yol yüzeyi arasındaki sürtünmeye dayalı tutunmadır. Buz gibi kaygan yüzeylerde azalır ve araç kayabilir.
5faa949ff970842c2f50aa3e664971d0fa3b4c36.gloss: Lastik ile yol arasındaki, aracın hızını durdurmaya yardım eden tutunma.

5faa949ff970842c2f50aa3e664971d0fa3b4c36.translation: Buzda çekiş azdır, bu yüzden araç düşük hızda bile kayabilir.
บนน้ำแข็งแรงยึดเกาะมีน้อย รถจึงลื่นไถลแม้จะขับด้วยความเร็วต่ำ
Cengkeramannya sedikit di atas es, sehingga mobil meluncur bahkan pada kecepatan rendah.
Há pouca aderência no gelo, por isso o carro desliza mesmo em baixa velocidade.
얼음 길에서는 그립력이 약해서 자동차가 낮은 속도로도 미끄러진다.
氷の上ではグリップ（FIFO）が弱いため、低い速度でも車が滑る。

5faa949ff970842c2f50aa3e664971d0fa3b4c36.text: There is little traction on ice, so the car slides even at a low speed.
5faa949ff970842c2f50aa3e664971d0fa3b4c36.translation: Trên băng có ít độ bám, nên xe trượt ngay cả khi đang chạy với tốc độ thấp.

5fc3cc50513e1d9f90ed7e3d1bfb7acfbba49efc.definition: A burn caused by hot liquid or steam.
5fc3cc50513e1d9f90ed7e3d1bfb7acfbba49efc.gloss: A burn caused by hot liquid or steam.

5fc3cc50513e1d9f90ed7e3d1bfb7acfbba49efc.definition: 高温の液体や水蒸気が皮膚に触れて生じるやけど。低温の湯によるやけどとは区別される。
5fc3cc50513e1d9f90ed7e3d1bfb7acfbba49efc.gloss: 熱い液体や蒸気によるやけど。

5fc3cc50513e1d9f90ed7e3d1bfb7acfbba49efc.definition: 뜨거운 물이나 증기가 피부에 닿아 생기는 화상이다. 불처럼 보이는 화상보다 깊은 조직까지 손상될 수 있는 경우도 있다.
5fc3cc50513e1d9f90ed7e3d1bfb7acfbba49efc.gloss: 뜨거운 물이나 증기에 의해 입는 화상.

5fc3cc50513e1d9f90ed7e3d1bfb7acfbba49efc.definition: Lesão da pele causada por contato com líquido quente ou vapor, diferente de uma queimadura por fogo.
5fc3cc50513e1d9f90ed7e3d1bfb7acfbba49efc.gloss: Queimadura causada por líquido quente ou vapor.

5fc3cc50513e1d9f90ed7e3d1bfb7acfbba49efc.definition: Luka bakar akibatisentuhan dengan cairan atau uap panas, biasanya karena suhu air yang terlalu tinggi.
5fc3cc50513e1d9f90ed7e3d1bfb7acfbba49efc.gloss: Luka bakar akibat cairan atau uap panas.

5fc3cc50513e1d9f90ed7e3d1bfb7acfbba49efc.definition: อาการผิวหนังถูกความร้อนจากของเหลวร้อนหรือไอน้ำทำให้ลวก ซึ่งอาจเกิดได้เร็วแม้อุณหภูมิไม่สูงมากนัก
5fc3cc50513e1d9f90ed7e3d1bfb7acfbba49efc.gloss: อาการถูกน้ำร้อนหรือไอน้ำลวก

5fc3cc50513e1d9f90ed7e3d1bfb7acfbba49efc.definition: Kaynar su, sıcak sıvı veya buharın ciltle teması sonucu oluşan yanma; termal yaralanmanın özel bir türüdür.
5fc3cc50513e1d9f90ed7e3d1bfb7acfbba49efc.gloss: Sıcak sıvı veya buhardan kaynaklanan yanma.

5fc3cc50513e1d9f90ed7e3d1bfb7acfbba49efc.translation: 60 °C su bir çocuğu yalnızca birkaç saniyede haşlayabilir.
น้ำที่อุณหภูมิ 60 °C สามารถทำให้เด็กลวกภายในไม่กี่วินาที
Air pada suhu 60 °C dapat menyebabkan luka bakar pada anak dalam hitungan detik.
Água a 60 °C pode causar uma escaldadura em uma criança em poucos segundos.
60 °C의 물은 몇 초 만에 아이에게 화상을 입힐 수 있다.
60 ℃の湯は数秒で子どもにやけどを負わせる。

5fc3cc50513e1d9f90ed7e3d1bfb7acfbba49efc.text: Water at 60 °C can scald a child in a few seconds.
5fc3cc50513e1d9f90ed7e3d1bfb7acfbba49efc.translation: Nước ở 60 °C có thể gây bỏng cho trẻ trong vài giây.

5fe989f3998228743dead97df64b853f38775513.definition: The difference in age between two partners, and the direction of that difference.
5fe989f3998228743dead97df64b853f38775513.gloss: The difference in age between two partners, and the direction of that difference.

5fe989f3998228743dead97df64b853f38775513.definition: 두 연인 사이의 나이가 몇 년 차이 나는지를 뜻하며, 어느 쪽이 더 나이가 많은지도 함께 나타낸다. 단순히 나이의 차이만 말하는 경우와 나이 많은 쪽을 밝히는 경우가 모두 쓰인다.
5fe989f3998228743dead97df64b853f38775513.gloss: 두 연인 사이의 나이 차이와 그 방향.

5fe989f3998228743dead97df64b853f38775513.definition: Diferença de idade entre dois parceiros, que pode ser indicada também pela direção: quem é o mais velho e quem é o mais novo.
5fe989f3998228743dead97df64b853f38775513.gloss: A diferença de idade entre dois parceiros e o sentido dessa diferença.

5fe989f3998228743dead97df64b853f38775513.definition: Jarak antara usia dua pasangan, termasuk siapa yang lebih tua dan siapa yang lebih muda.
5fe989f3998228743dead97df64b853f38775513.gloss: Perbedaan usia antara dua pasangan beserta arah perbedaannya.

5fe989f3998228743dead97df64b853f38775513.definition: ความแตกต่างในอายุของคู่ครอง รวมถึงการระบุว่าอีกฝ่ายอายุมากหรือน้อยกว่า
5fe989f3998228743dead97df64b853f38775513.gloss: ความต่างระหว่างวัยของคู่ครอง

5fe989f3998228743dead97df64b853f38775513.definition: Bir çiftin üyeleri arasındaki yaş farkı. Bu farkın yönü, eşlerden hangisinin daha yaşlı olduğunu da belirtir.
5fe989f3998228743dead97df64b853f38775513.gloss: İki eş arasındaki yaş farkı ve hangisinin daha yaşlı olduğu.

5fe989f3998228743dead97df64b853f38775513.definition: 名詞。交際相手との年齢の差を表す言葉で、差の大きさだけでなく年上の側が含まれる。
5fe989f3998228743dead97df64b853f38775513.gloss: 恋人同士などの年齢差と、どちらが年上かという意味での向き。

5fe989f3998228743dead97df64b853f38775513.translation: 年齢差は四歳で、彼女の方が年上だった。
Yaş farkı dört yıldı ve eşlerden kadın daha yaşlıydı.
ความต่างระหว่างวัยของพวกเขาอยู่ที่สี่ปี โดยเธอเป็นฝ่ายที่อายุมากกว่า
Kesenjangan usia mereka empat tahun, dan dia yang lebih tua.
A diferença de idade era de quatro anos, e ela era a mais velha.
두 사람의 나이 차이는 네 살이었고, 그녀가 나이가 더 많았다.

5fe989f3998228743dead97df64b853f38775513.text: The age gap was four years, and she was the older one.
